{{Quote|They again cited that Wookiee representation of the Kashyyyk system in the Senate has historically been to the detriment of the Trandoshan people.|Extract from the HoloNet News Vol. 531 48|<ref name="HNN48" />}}
The '''Kashyyyk Senatorial Delegation''' was the [[Politics/Legends|political]] body that represented the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] and the rest of the [[Mytaranor sector/Legends|Mytaranor sector]] during the last [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. It consisted of a [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Senator/Legends|senator]] and his or her [[Aide/Legends|aides]]. Despite their short tempers, Wookiee senators were respected for their firm sense of justice.<ref name="TPMV">''[[Star Wars: Episode I: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> The [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshans]], another species from the Mytaranor sector, were resentful of the fact that Wookiees alone would represent their common area of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] in the pan-[[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] political arena.<ref name="HNN48">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|48|regional/13321_1.html|Kashyyyk/Trandoshan Talks to Shaky Start}}</ref>
